```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g., 0.4.1)'
        required: true
        default: '0.4.1'
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run (build & validate only, no publish/push)'
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate-secrets:
    name: Validate Secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check required secrets
        run: |
          missing=()
          for secret in SONATYPE_USERNAME SONATYPE_PASSWORD GPG_PRIVATE_KEY GPG_PASSPHRASE DOCKERHUB_USER DOCKERHUB_TOKEN; do
            if [ -z "${!secret}" ]; then
              missing+=("$secret")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing required secrets: ${missing[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required secrets are present."

  release:
    name: Build & Release
    needs: validate-secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Import GPG Key
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" | gpg --batch --import
          echo "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" | gpg --batch --passphrase-fd 0 --pinentry-mode loopback --sign /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Configure Maven Settings
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.m2
          cat > ~/.m2/settings.xml <<EOF
          <settings>
            <servers>
              <server>
                <id>central</id>
                <username>${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}</username>
                <password>${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}</password>
              </server>
            </servers>
          </settings>
          EOF

      - name: Build and Test
        run: mvn clean verify -B -V

      - name: Publish to Maven Central & Docker Hub
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        env:
          DOCKERHUB_USER: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
        run: |
          mvn deploy -Prelease -B -V \
            -DskipTests \
            -Dgpg.passphrase="${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" \
            -Dcentral.autoPublish=true \
            -Dcentral.waitForPublishing=true

      - name: Update Documentation Versions
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION"
          echo "Updating documentation for version $VERSION"
          
          # Find all markdown files
          find . -name "*.md" -type f | while read -r file; do
            # Skip target directories
            if [[ "$file" == *"target/"* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            
            # Update Docker tags: rrobetti/ojp:OLD -> rrobetti/ojp:NEW
            sed -i "s|rrobetti/ojp:[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\(-SNAPSHOT\)\?|rrobetti/ojp:${VERSION}|g" "$file"
            
            # Update JAR filenames: ojp-server-OLD.jar -> ojp-server-NEW.jar
            sed -i "s|ojp-server-[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\(-SNAPSHOT\)\?\.jar|ojp-server-${VERSION}.jar|g" "$file"
            
            # Update Maven Central URLs: /0.4.1/ -> /NEW/
            sed -i "s|/0\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/|/${VERSION}/|g" "$file"
            
            # Update Maven coordinates: <version>OLD</version> -> <version>NEW</version>
            # This is a simple heuristic; complex cases may need manual review
            sed -i "s|<version>[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\(-SNAPSHOT\)\?</version>|<version>${VERSION}</version>|g" "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit Documentation Updates
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --staged --quiet; then
            git commit -m "docs: update version references to ${VERSION}"
            git push origin HEAD
          else
            echo "No documentation changes to commit."
          fi

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ inputs.version }}
          name: Release ${{ inputs.version }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Dry Run Summary
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
        run: |
          echo "## Dry Run Completed" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Version: ${{ inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Build: Successful" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Publish: Skipped (Dry Run)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Push: Skipped (Dry Run)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
